20: -- Compute the total detection ability of enemies to see through stealth
21: -- Each foe loses 10% detection power per tile beyond range 1
22: -- returns detect, closest = total detection power, distance to closest enemy
23: -- if estimate is true, only counts the detection power of seen actors
24: local function stealthDetection(self, radius, estimate)
25: 	if not self.x then return 0, math.huge end
26: 	local dist = 0
27: 	local closest, detect = math.huge, 0
28: 	for i, act in ipairs(self.fov.actors_dist) do
29: 		dist = core.fov.distance(self.x, self.y, act.x, act.y)
30: 		if dist > radius then break end
31: 		if act ~= self and act:reactionToward(self) < 0 and not act:attr("blind") and (not act.fov or not act.fov.actors or act.fov.actors[self]) and (not estimate or self:canSee(act)) then
32: 			detect = detect + act:combatSeeStealth() * (1.1 - dist/10) -- detection strength reduced 10% per tile
33: 			if dist < closest then closest = dist end
34: 		end
35: 	end
36: 	return detect, closest
37: end
38: Talents.stealthDetection = stealthDetection
